_comment: Golden corpus for ENH-2883 pre-refactor baseline. codex agent (TOML) emission byte-identity. Gemini agent emission is excluded (degraded-mode preview stub, covered by ENH-2874 tests, not a native-format byte-identity claim). omp is excluded entirely (postdates the ENH-2883 refactor this module snapshots; emit_agent/emit_skill/emit_command are all real as of FEAT-3104/FEAT-3105 but covered separately in test_adapters.py, not this golden-corpus claim). BUG-3640: `codex_toml` values below omit `model = "..."` because every case's `input_content` uses a Claude Code model alias (sonnet/opus/haiku), which is now stripped rather than shipped verbatim. ENH-3533: `agent-model-hint` declares `model_hint: coding` + `model: sonnet`; with no built-in Codex mapping the TOML carries neither `model` nor the hint.
